acts.title: Act I: Earthbound
acts.setting: Eli's apartment. Dim lighting, a desk with a laptop, a couch, a TV. Outside: night.

steps.text: Eli Wallace, 25, math dropout, gamer. It's 2 AM. You're at your desk, deep in a video game. Another night, another leaderboard climb.
Press E to interact with your laptop.

steps.speaker: Eli
steps.text: Okay, one more level. If I can crack this cipher puzzle, I'm top ten on the leaderboard.
A strange symbol appears on screen — not part of the game. It looks like... a constellation? No, a coordinate. Something unlocks in the code.

steps.speaker: Eli
steps.text: Wait. That's not a game puzzle. Someone embedded something in this code. A... math proof? A coordinate system?

steps.speaker: Eli
steps.text: No way. That's a real-world location. Somewhere in... Montana? That can't be right.
A knock at the door. It's 2:47 AM. You weren't expecting anyone.

steps.speaker: Sgt. Greer
steps.text: Eli Wallace? You need to come with us. Right now. Bring your laptop.

steps.speaker: Eli
steps.text: What? Who are you? I'm not going anywhere with —

steps.speaker: Sgt. Greer
steps.text: Son, you just solved a problem the entire US Air Force couldn't. That makes you the most important person on Earth right now. We have a car outside. Let's go.
Forty-eight hours later. Icarus Base — a secret military installation deep inside a mountain on another planet.

acts.title: Act II: Icarus Base
acts.setting: Underground military base. Concrete corridors, emergency lighting, Stargate control room visible through a window.

steps.text: Icarus Base. You've been here for two days. They showed you the Stargate — a ring that opens wormholes to other planets. It's real. All of it.
Use W/A/S/D to walk. Move toward Colonel Young.

steps.speaker: Col. Young
steps.text: Eli. Glad you're here. Dr. Rush thinks the ninth chevron on that gate can be dialed — if we can figure out the power requirements. That's why we need you.

steps.speaker: Eli
steps.text: Me? I solved a video game puzzle. I'm not a... I don't even have a degree.

steps.speaker: Col. Young
steps.text: That 'video game puzzle' was a coded recruitment test. You solved what our best mathematicians couldn't. Now — go meet Dr. Rush in the control room. He'll explain the math.
Look around with the mouse. Press E to interact with people and objects.

steps.speaker: Dr. Rush
steps.text: Ah, Mr. Wallace. I'm Dr. Nicholas Rush. The ninth chevron problem is... elegant. The standard seven-chevron dial uses stars as reference points. The ninth requires something... more.

steps.speaker: Dr. Rush
steps.text: I need you to verify a formula. The power requirements for a nine-chevron address are different from anything we've attempted. I believe the answer lies in the relationship between the gate's zero-point module and the planet's geothermal energy.
Press E to use the control console. Match the symbol pattern shown on screen.

steps.speaker: Eli
steps.text: Okay, so if I align the power coupling to the geothermal frequency... and carry the excess through the gate's capacitor... That's it. The formula works. We can dial the ninth chevron.

steps.speaker: Dr. Rush
steps.text: Remarkable. You've done in two days what I couldn't do in two years. Colonel — we're ready to attempt the dial.
The alarms start screaming. The base shakes. Something is very wrong.

steps.speaker: Col. Young
steps.text: We're under attack! Three Ha'tak-class ships just dropped out of orbit. They're bombarding the planet!

steps.speaker: Col. Young
steps.text: Everyone to the gate room! We're dialing the ninth chevron NOW. This isn't a test anymore — it's an evacuation!

acts.title: Act III: Evacuation
acts.setting: Gate room. The Stargate is spinning. Explosions rock the base. The mountain is collapsing.

steps.text: The base is collapsing! Sprint to the gate room — hold SHIFT to run!
The corridors are shaking. Lights flicker. People are running past you. The ceiling cracks overhead.

steps.speaker: Lt. Scott
steps.text: Eli! Move it! We're dialing the ninth chevron — whatever comes through, we're going through!
Press E at the gate control console to lock the ninth chevron!
The gate spins. Seven chevrons lock. Eight. The ninth... the base shakes harder. Power surges through the walls.

steps.speaker: Eli
steps.text: Come on... come on... LOCK! The ninth chevron engages!
The wormhole erupts — a burst of unstable vortex, then a shimmering blue pool of light. The gate is open. But to where?

steps.speaker: Col. Young
steps.text: Everyone through the gate! NOW! That's an order!

steps.speaker: Dr. Rush
steps.text: We don't know where it goes. It could be anywhere in the universe. But staying here is death. Go, Mr. Wallace. Go!
Walk into the Stargate event horizon to step through.
The wormhole swallows you. A tunnel of light. You feel your body stretched across the universe... and then...
You're thrown out onto a cold metal floor. Darkness. The smell of ancient air. You're aboard the Destiny — a ship billions of light-years from home.
